scope: Exact workload-owned MLX custom-kernel implementation of the pinned Parakeet waveform-to-mel frontend

contract.input: One non-empty float32 waveform at 16 kHz, no longer than 480000 samples
contract.output: float32 mel [3001,128], all-one int32 mask [3001], float32 encoder features [1,3000,128], and int32 encoder mask [1,3000]
contract.execution: Every waveform-dependent stage uses workload-owned mx.fast.metal_kernel calls on stream=mx.gpu. NumPy is imported only after GPU evaluation by the fixture comparator.
contract.success: All certified stage and final bytes must match and positive GPU primitive, Vulkan compute, and Vulkan submission counters must be observed.
